country_event = {
	id = ac_ud_up.1
	title = ac_ud_up.1.t
	desc = ac_ud_up.1.d
	picture = GFX_ac_ud_event_politics
	is_triggered_only = yes
	trigger = {
		original_tag = SNS
	}
	option = {
		name = ac_ud_up.1.a
		ai_chance = { factor = 5 }
		add_stability = -0.01
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = ac_up_initialized }
			add_to_variable = { ac_up_sns_continuity = 2 }
			ac_up_bound = yes
			ac_up_recalculate = yes
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = ac_ud_up.1.b
		ai_chance = { factor = 10 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = ac_up_initialized }
			add_to_variable = { ac_up_sns_dispatch = 2 }
			ac_up_bound = yes
			ac_up_recalculate = yes
		}
	}
}

	trigger = {
		original_tag = DEL
	}
	option = {
		name = ac_ud_up.47.a
		ai_chance = { factor = 10 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = ac_up_initialized }
			add_to_variable = { ac_up_del_oversight = 3 }
			ac_up_bound = yes
			ac_up_recalculate = yes
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = ac_ud_up.47.b
		ai_chance = { factor = 5 }
		add_stability = 0.01
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = ac_up_initialized }
			add_to_variable = { ac_up_del_records = 3 }
			ac_up_bound = yes
			ac_up_recalculate = yes
		}
	}
